title: Transparent background toggle in the Prompt Box (Qwen-Image 2.1)
description: Fabio 2026-10-09: an on/off Prompt Box control to choose whether a Qwen-Image 2.1 image comes without a background. Viable: 2.1's transparency is PROMPT-ONLY (no graph switch), and alpha survives only on t2i and edit (every other op drops it with SplitImageWithAlpha). So: a ComponentFactory toggle shown only for qwen-image-2-1 on t2i/edit (a capability flag in models.js, e.g. capabilities.transparentBackground), and at dispatch the app wraps the prompt in the vendor sentences: prefix 'This is an RGBA image with transparency.' and suffix 'The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.' Enhance must receive the flag so the qwen-image-2.1 recipe (MPI-1048) describes no background; Cosmo/MCP get it as a named param (namedParamsFor). Verify mode user-ux: Fabio's eye on t2i + edit, alpha checked on the saved card (measured 59-69% clear in MPI-936).
